description: Use this when a homeowner asks which lenders offer a HELOC or home equity loan in their state, or wants lenders sorted by rate, upfront fees, time to money or name. Do not use for purchase mortgages, quotes to refinance the first mortgage (a rate-and-term or cash-out refinance), rent-versus-buy, credit card questions or general rate news. Returns named lenders, including lenders that pay Alauda nothing, each with its rate in percent (advertised, or a category estimate where the lender publishes none), fees in US dollars or percent, usual days to money and source page. Rows are sorted only by the criterion chosen; they are not quotes or offers. Lender and rate data cover California and Florida. Alauda runs this tool and it is free for homeowners; when a homeowner applies through our licensed mortgage partner, the lender pays that partner and the partner pays Alauda.

amount_wanted.description: The cash the homeowner wants to receive, in US dollars. Leave out when unknown.

limit.description: Most rows to return, 1-5 (default 5); fewer come back when they would not fit, and next_offset continues the list.

offset.description: Rows to skip: pass next_offset from the last result to see more (default 0).

product.description: heloc: a line of credit. home_equity_loan: one lump sum at a fixed rate.

sort_by.description: The order the homeowner asked for. lowest_upfront_fees needs amount_wanted, since some fees are a percentage and some a flat dollar figure.

state.description: Two-letter code of the US state the home is in, for example CA.

name: search_home_equity_lenders

as_of.description: Date the catalog's newest figure was read (YYYY-MM-DD).

confidence.description: high when nothing that would change the result is missing, medium when one thing is, low when more are or the state is not covered.

general_information.description: Always true: this is general information.

non_partner_options_included.description: True when the result draws on lenders that pay Alauda nothing.

not_an_offer.description: Always true: nothing here is an offer.

ranking_basis.description: How any list in this result is ordered.

who_pays_us.description: Who pays Alauda. Show it with any lender or rate information.

ignored_fields.description: Parameters dropped because they looked like an SSN or a street address, or because this tool no longer takes them: names only, the first 5.

inputs_used.description: The inputs this result was computed from.

response_requirements.description: Rules any reply built on this result keeps.

days_to_money.description: Usual days from application to money.

high.description: Computed by Alauda: the same range's high end, in days.

low.description: Computed by Alauda: Alauda's usual range for this kind of lender (online lender, bank or credit union), not the lender's own figure: low end, in days.

fee_pct.description: One-time fee as a percent of the loan. Absent when upfront fees are unconfirmed. From the lender's entry in our catalog, which records no page or date for it.

fees_at_amount_usd.description: Computed by Alauda: fee_pct of amount_wanted plus flat_fees_usd. Absent without amount_wanted.

flat_fees_usd.description: One-time flat fees in US dollars. Absent when upfront fees are unconfirmed. From the lender's entry in our catalog, which records no page or date for it.

partner.description: True when this lender pays our licensed mortgage partner (and so Alauda) if the homeowner borrows.

rate_pct.description: The lender's rate in percent: advertised on its own page, or where rate_kind is estimated a category average.

source.description: Page the figure was read from.

next_offset.description: The offset that shows the next rows. Absent at the end of the list.

what_would_make_this_more_accurate.description: Parameter names that were not given and would change the result.

title: Search home equity lenders
